title: טכנאיאינטגרציה — מערכות אוטונומיות
snippet:
פתרונות סולאריים
מתכננת ומייצרת מתקנים אוטונומיים המשלבים אנרגיה סולארית, אגירה ותקשורת אלחוטית — מערכות שעובדות 24/7 גם בלי תשתית חשמל או תקשורת. מעל 1,000 מערכות מקוונות ברחבי הארץ.
אנחנו מחפשים טכנאי אינטגרציה לצוות שלנו ברשפון.
התפקיד
הרכבה, אינטגרציה והפעלה של מערכות אוטונומיות — מהתכנון בסדנה ועד ההתקנה בשטח (עבודת ידיים של הרכבת מערכות). כולל איתור ופתרון תקלות, בסדנה ומול מערכות מרוחקות.
יתרון
רקע בתקשורת רדיו, סלולרית או קווית
רקע בחשמל אלקטרוניקה
ניסיון בהרכבה, הפעלה ותחזוקה — בסדנה ובשטח
חשוב לדעת
התפקיד כולל יציאה להתקנות בשטח, ולעיתים עבודה בגובה.

title: Field System QA
snippet:
At
D-Fend Solutions
, our people are our greatest strength — and technology is our passion. Our team of innovators and subject matter experts, including veterans of elite military intelligence technology units, is transforming the way organizations protect themselves from drone threats.
As the global leader in
cyber-takeover counter-drone technology
, we design and deliver advanced, software-defined solutions that empower our customers to detect, take control, and safely land unauthorized drones — with precision and reliability.
Every day, we push the boundaries of innovation to meet real-world security challenges across industries and environments. We’re proud of our cutting-edge technology, our global reach, and the impact we make in securing the skies.
We’re seeking passionate professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, creative, and collaborative environment — those who want to be part of the next generation of airspace security innovation.
Join D-Fend Solutions and help make the world a safer place.
Become a D-Fender!
Work with the world’s leading cyber-takeover counter-drone technology provider and shape the future of safe airspace.
Scope:
We are looking for Field System QA.
Our ideal candidate is a proactive learner with excellent problem-solving skills and a strong desire to work hands-on with system testing and verification.
While no prior professional experience is necessary, a natural curiosity for how systems work and an enthusiasm for tackling challenges in diverse, outdoor settings are highly valued.
This role is highly hands-on and field-oriented, with the majority of time spent conducting outdoor system tests in real-world environments. You will be actively involved in end-to-end validation of complex hardware and software systems, troubleshooting issues on-site, and working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure optimal performance.
The position requires adaptability, independence, and a proactive approach, as you will operate in dynamic, fast-changing conditions and take ownership of testing activities from execution through reporting.
What will your job look like?
Verifying system features and functionality
Outdoor system performance tests
Working in a young, dynamic & demanding environment on cutting edge technology
Conduct end-to-end testing of integrated hardware and software components, ensuring seamless operation
Provide detailed bug reports, logs, and reproducible steps for issues found in the field
Generate regular reports on field QA activities, system performance trends, and key findings
Requirements:
Experience working with command & control, embedded, radio, or drone systems - Advantage
Willingness to work on Fridays and travel abroad (approximately 15% of the time) - Must
Previous experience with field activity - Must
This role requires significant hands-on involvement, with approximately 70% of the time dedicated to outdoor testing
High sense of ownership
Comfortable taking initiative
Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-changing, and multidisciplinary environment
Highly motivated, self-driven, independent, and detail-oriented
B.Sc. - Advantage
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Grid & Interconnection Coordinator
snippet: Description: We are seeking a coordinator to join our Renewable Energy Development Department to serve as a central function within the department’s electrical sector, acting as a grid and interconnection coordinator in the electricity field.   The coordinator will work closely with project managers, engineering teams, advisors, and senior management, providing operational support to the department's electrical sector, managing documentation and ongoing follow-up with the IEC, Noga, and design consultants.  | Responsibilities: Managing and tracking grid connection requests, including Distribution System Operator (DSO) responses, connection surveys, technical coordination, and various procedures with the IEC and Noga.   Documenting, consolidating, and archiving connection files, electrical design documents, schematics, and inspection reports, including management via the Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) ordering portal.   Handling administrative processing of IEC and Noga vouchers and fees, bank guarantees, and contractual engagements in coordination with IEC representatives and internal finance departments.   Coordinating internal and joint site visits with the IEC, scheduling working meetings, and conducting routine status updates with the IEC and Noga.   | Requirements: 1–3 years of experience in operational or administrative roles within an engineering, infrastructure, electrical, or planning company.  Bachelor's degree / Practical Engineer in Industrial Engineering & Management or Electrical Engineering – an advantage.   Experience in engineering, infrastructure, or electrical design – an advantage.  Experience working with Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) / Noga mechanisms, including familiarity with terms and forms for electrical facilities and energy storage systems – a significant advantage.  Hands-on experience with the Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) ordering portal – a significant advantage.  Full proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and CRM/ERP systems (Priority, Monday).  Basic ability to read engineering and electrical documentation.

title: NOC Team Member
snippet:
סלקום מחפשת את האנשים שיעצבו את שוק התקשורת בישראל
למה סלקום? סלקום מובילה את תחום התקשורת הסלולרית בארץ לצד מוצרי טכנולוגיה מתקדמים כגון TV OTT שירות טלוויזיה ,TV סלקום ושירותי תשתית תקשורת אופטית המבוססת על תשתיות טכנולוגיות מתקדמות.
העובדים שלנו נמצאים בחזית הטכנולוגיה ומובילים את פיתוחי המוצרים המובילים בשוק התקשורת.
אנחנו מגייסים
בקר/ית תפעול הרשת
מיקום: נתניה
מה התפקיד כולל?
תפקיד בקרת הרשת מהווה את מרכז העצבים של רשת סלקום, ומהווה נקודת שליטה קריטית על כלל מערכות ליבת הסלולר, הרדיו, התמסורת ושירותי ה-ISP. בתפקיד זה תיחשף לטכנולוגיות המתקדמות ביותר בעולם התקשורת ותהיה גורם מוביל בזיהוי, ניתוח ופתרון תקלות המשפיעות על מיליוני לקוחות.
התפקיד מהווה אחד התפקידים המרכזיים בבקרה השוטפת של רשת סלקום ומשפיע ישירות על יציבות וזמינות השירותים ללקוחות החברה.
ניטור ובקרה פרואקטיבית על רשת תקשורת מורכבת תוך זיהוי מוקדם של תקלות והשפעות פוטנציאליות על השירות ברשת ההנדסית של קבוצת סלקום:
ליבת הסלולר.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Maker
snippet:
About Us
Tevel develops autonomous flying robots for fruit harvesting, combining drones, AI and robotics to address the labor shortage in agriculture.
About the Role
We are looking for a curious, creative and hands-on Maker to join our development team and play a key role in developing, improving and testing our products and technologies, from concept to field. This is a role for doers: someone who enjoys taking things apart, building, improving, and finding creative solutions for the company's future products.
Responsibilities
Design, build and assemble prototypes and mechanical assemblies for drones
Develop and continuously improve mechanisms, structures and mechanical interfaces
Manufacture parts using a variety of technologies, such as 3D printing, machining and composite materials
Conduct tests and experiments, and troubleshoot issues in the lab and in the field
Work closely with software, mechanical, electronics and field operations teams
Propose new ideas and solutions to improve performance, reliability and maintainability
Requirements
Mechanical engineering technician or mechanical engineer
Hands-on experience with drones or RC aircraft (professional or as a serious hobby)
Experience in robotics, product development and prototyping
Proficiency in SolidWorks or equivalent

Tevel develops autonomous flying robots for fruit harvesting, combining drones, AI and robotics to address the labor shortage in agriculture.
About the Role
We are looking for a curious, creative and hands-on Maker to join our development team and play a key role in developing, improving and testing our products and technologies, from concept to field. This is a role for doers: someone who enjoys taking things apart, building, improving, and finding creative solutions for the company's future products.
Responsibilities
Design, build and assemble prototypes and mechanical assemblies for drones
Develop and continuously improve mechanisms, structures and mechanical interfaces
Manufacture parts using a variety of technologies, such as 3D printing, machining and composite materials

Work closely with software, mechanical, electronics and field operations teams

title: Capacity Installation Technician, Data Center, Infrastructure Delivery
snippet:
Description
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, ability to build, invent, and simplify a resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.
We are expanding our technician teams and have openings for Installation Technicians. This is an entry level position and a unique opportunity to work in some of the most innovative and fast paced data centers in the world. The Infrastructure Delivery team is responsible for the scaling and physical deployment of new data center infrastructure. As part of that team, you will be primarily tasked with installing cabling and new racks within the data centers. You must be able to perform repetitive tasks and adhere to standard processes and best practices. You will be working in a team environment and must be able to communicate and promote cross-team functionality.
Key job responsibilities
Basic build and troubleshooting of network devices.
Creating/attaching labels and barcodes.
Managing inventory of related materials.
Adhering to defined escalation processes and standard operating procedures.
Physical Requirements
This position has a physical component and may require working in cramped spaces or elevated locations.
Manual handling and lifting of equipment may be required (weight limits in accordance with regulations)
Regularly work at heights and from ladders.
Work in noisy areas with hotter and colder temperatures than standard office environmental conditions.
Personal car and ability to travel within geographical work area is required.
About The Team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic Qualifications
1+ years of computer networking experience
High school or equivalent diploma
Preferred Qualifications
Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
technical certification in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Grid & Interconnection Coordinator
snippet:
We are seeking a coordinator to join our Renewable Energy Development Department to serve as a central function within the department’s electrical sector, acting as a grid and interconnection coordinator in the electricity field.
The coordinator will work closely with project managers, engineering teams, advisors, and senior management, providing operational support to the department's electrical sector, managing documentation and ongoing follow-up with the IEC, Noga, and design consultants.
Responsibilities:
Managing and tracking grid connection requests, including Distribution System Operator (DSO) responses, connection surveys, technical coordination, and various procedures with the IEC and Noga.
Documenting, consolidating, and archiving connection files, electrical design documents, schematics, and inspection reports, including management via the Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) ordering portal.
Handling administrative processing of IEC and Noga vouchers and fees, bank guarantees, and contractual engagements in coordination with IEC representatives and internal finance departments.
Coordinating internal and joint site visits with the IEC, scheduling working meetings, and conducting routine status updates with the IEC and Noga.
Requirements:
1–3 years of experience in operational or administrative roles within an engineering, infrastructure, electrical, or planning company.
Bachelor's degree / Practical Engineer in Industrial Engineering & Management or Electrical Engineering – an advantage.
Experience in engineering, infrastructure, or electrical design – an advantage.
Experience working with Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) / Noga mechanisms, including familiarity with terms and forms for electrical facilities and energy storage systems – a significant advantage.
Hands-on experience with the Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) ordering portal – a significant advantage.
Full proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and CRM/ERP systems (Priority, Monday).
Basic ability to read engineering and electrical documentation.

התפקיד מהווה חלק ממערך השירות של החברה וכולל עבודה בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת עם מערכות בקרה ומכשור של טורבינות גז.
במסגרת התפקיד תהיה/,תהיי בעל אחריות מקצועית ישירה על איתור, אבחון ופתרון תקלות,
ביצוע תחזוקה ותמיכה טכנית במערכות קריטיות, תוך עבודה מול הלקוח ובשיתוף פעולה שוטף עם צוותי מומחים בארץ ובחו"ל.
תחומי אחריות :
איתור, אבחון ופתרון תקלות מורכבות במערכות בקרה ומכשור.
עבודה מעשית עם מערכות PLC/HMI, כולל קריאת לוגיקות בקרה, דיאגנוסטיקה ואיתור תקלות.
עבודה עם חיישנים, משדרים (Transmitters), שסתומי בקרה ומערכות עזר תעשייתיות.
ביצוע תחזוקה מונעת ומתקנת במערכות קריטיות.
ביצוע בדיקות פונקציונליות, שינויים והתאמות במערכות בקרה.
ביצוע תהליכי דיאגנוסטיקה ו-Root Cause Analysis לצורך ניתוח תקלות ומניעת הישנותן.
תמיכה בפעילויות Commissioning, Start-up והשבתות מתוכננות.
מתן מענה טכני מקצועי ושוטף ללקוח באתר.
עבודה משותפת עם צוותי Engineering ו-Product Support בישראל ובחו"ל.
הכנת דוחות טכניים ותיעוד פעילויות השירות.
השתתפות בכוננויות ומתן מענה לקריאות שירות בהתאם לצורכי האתר.
דרישות התפקיד
מהנדס/ת או הנדסאי/ת חשמל, בקרה, מכשור, אלקטרוניקה, מכטרוניקה או תחום טכני רלוונטי.
ניסיון מעשי בתחומי בקרה, מכשור, אחזקה או שירות בסביבה תעשייתית.

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
חברה לשירות ושיפוץ משאבות מים באזור התעשייה לב הארץ בראש העין מגייסת טכנאי שירות לעבודה משולבת בשטח ובמפעל!
8,000 ₪ נטו למתלמד בלי ניסיון ו-10,000 ₪ נטו לבעלי ניסיון, בלי שישי!!
תיאור התפקיד:
- אבחון, שירות, פירוק ושיפוץ של משאבות מים: הגברת לחץ, כיבוי אש, מי תהום, מרתפים ועוד
- יציאה לשטח בזוגות לקריאות שירות, מגדרה ועד חדרה
- פירוק המשאבה והבאתה לשיפוץ במפעל, או שיפוץ באתר
- החזרת המשאבה לפעילות תקינה אצל הלקוח
- עבודה פיזית קלה, עם אביזרי עזר ייעודיים
שכר ותנאים:
- מתלמד בלי ניסיון: 8,000 ₪ נטו בהתחלה
- בעל ניסיון ורקע טכני: 10,000 ₪ נטו בהתחלה, עם אפשרות להעלאה בהמשך
- משרה מלאה, א'-ה' 08:00-17:00, בלי שישי
- מיקום: אזור התעשייה לב הארץ, ראש העין, ועבודת שטח מגדרה ועד חדרה
דרישות התפקיד
- רישיון נהיגה.
- נכונות לעבודה משולבת בשטח ובמפעל, בזוגות.
- רישיון נהיגה ג' - יתרון משמעותי!
- ניסיון בשיפוץ או בתחזוקת משאבות, צנרת, מכניקה או מערכות מים - יתרון משמעותי!
שליחת קורות חיים או הגשת מועמדות מהווה הסכמה לכך שחברת ג׳וב ספייס בע״מ תשמור ותשתמש בפרטיך, לרבות למטרת פנייה אליך בנוגע למשרות נוספות ודומות ולהעברת פרטיך למעסיקים פוטנציאליים בעתיד.
השימוש במידע ייעשה בהתאם למדיניות הפרטיות של החברה ובה גם מידע על זכויותיך.
ניתן לסרב לשימוש עתידי כאמור במידע בשליחת ״תמחקו אותי״ או לפנות בכל שאלה או בקשה בנושא לכתובת privacy@jobspacepro.com.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

title: Delivery Project Manager- Israel
snippet:
Your mission
Delivery Project Manager - Israel- JD
We are seeking a Project Manager
to join our team, overseeing and commissioning projects while ensuring their successful execution. This role demands a highly organized individual with a data-driven mindset, substantial experience in managing complex projects, and the ability to lead effectively in a dynamic, multicultural environment. The ideal candidate will exhibit strong technical acumen, adaptability, and excellent problem-solving skills, alongside the capacity to work independently and collaboratively under pressure.
Your Mission
As a Project Manager, you will be at the forefront of ensuring the successful delivery of diverse projects, aligning with organizational goals, and fostering a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, ensuring timely delivery within scope, budget, and quality standards.
Coordinate internal and external resources for seamless project execution.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.
Oversee critical project milestones, including FAT, commissioning, SAT, and handovers.
Monitor project performance, manage KPIs, and create detailed documentation.
Resolve technical and operational issues in coordination with relevant divisions.
Ensure timely collection of payments aligned with project milestones.
Manage project resources, including engineers, contractors, and equipment.
Lead on-site supervision of delivery and commissioning processes.
Drive continuous improvement and development of organizational processes.
Your profile
At least 3 years of experience in project management, particularly in complex and large-scale environments.
Highly organized and data-driven with strong tracking and analytical capabilities.
Self-motivated with the ability to lead projects independently and manage without formal authority.
Strong problem-solving skills, with a wide perspective and strategic thinking.
Flexible, assertive, and thrives under pressure in a global, multicultural, matrix organization.
Proficient in tools such as Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Visio, MS Project, and Monday.
Technical background or inclination, with experience in renewable energy, power electronics, IT, electricity, or civil engineering being a significant advantage.
Fluent in Hebrew and English (C1 level), with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Engineering degree in electrical, mechanical, or electronics fields is a strong advantage.
Why us?
Why Sungrow Israel?
Industry Leadership: Be part of a company that’s driving the future of renewable energy and shaping a more sustainable world.
Exceptional Work Environment: Collaborate with top professionals in a supportive and dynamic culture.
Excellent Terms and Conditions: We offer competitive compensation packages and outstanding benefits that rank among the best in the industry.
Growth Opportunities: From career development to skill-building, Sungrow Israel provides the tools and support you need to succeed.
The true topic for this decade Is RENEWABLE ENERGY！
We are more than happy to state that not only we are leading this discourse, but we also offer the fitting solutions for it. We have the strongest PV-Inverter R&D there is and became the world`s biggest Inverter
Manufacturer, which we are extremely proud of! And now, for this decade, we are increasing our game, and you might become part of it!
Besides That, Many Things Await You
Opportunities for Career advancement
Bonus payment based on pre-agreed and signed KPI agreements
A multinational team awaits You with lots of european and transeuropean exchange!
Possibility for technical and commercial knowledge increasement in regard to string inverters, central inverters, inverter stations including transformer and switch gear and storage solutions
Technical and commercial training in our headquarter in Germany and even visits to the big R&D facility in China!
Join us in shaping the renewable energy landscape.
Apply to contribute to our success and be a vital part of our global team.
About Us
We are a green tech company with young creative minds.
We are fighting every day to make our mission happen –
Clean Power for All
!
With 870+GW of clean power presently installed worldwide, we are on the road to success!
Welcome at Sungrow
Founded in 1997 by University Professor Cao Renxian, Sungrow is a leader in the research and development of solar inverters with the largest dedicated R&D team in the industry and a broad product portfolio offering PV inverter solutions and energy storage systems for utility-scale, commercial & industrial, and residential applications, as well as internationally recognized floating PV plant solutions, NEV driving solutions, EV charging solutions and renewable hydrogen production systems.
Want to know more? Check out what working with us is like!

title: מפעיל/ת מכונה
snippet:
מפעיל/ת מכונה
דוקרט תעשיית אריזות בע"מ
כפר מסריק
3-4 שנים
עבודה מועדפת
לפני 3 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
למפעל "דוקרט" לייצור אריזות קרטון בכפר מסריק דרוש/ה מפעיל/ת מכונה ועובדים/ות כלליים/ות. זוהי הזדמנות מצוינת להשתלב בסביבת עבודה מתקדמת, דינמית ומעשית עם תנאים מעולים! העבודה הינה בקליטה ישירה כעובד/ת חברה מהיום הראשון, כוללת ארוחות מסודרות בחדר אוכל ואופציות קידום נרחבות.
מתאים לחיילים/ות משוחררים/ות – מוכר כעבודה מועדפת!
היקף: משרה מלאה בשתי משמרות.
מיקום: כפר מסריק (סמוך לאזור תעשייה עכו).
תנאים נוספים: ארוחות על חשבון החברה, חדר אוכל, תנאים סוציאליים מלאים מהיום הראשון.
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון קודם בהפעלת מכונות ייצור – יתרון משמעותי.
יכולת טכנית ונכונות ללמידת מערכות ייצור חדשות.
אחריות, מחויבות גבוהה ועמידה בזמנים.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

תמיכה בתפעול ובתחזוקה, איתור תקלות וקידום פתרונות.
תכנון ובקרה על תחזוקה מונעת ובדיקות תקופתיות.
ליווי פרויקטים הנדסיים ועבודה מול קבלנים וספקים.
מעקב וקידום תהליכי התייעלות אנרגטית ושיפור ביצועים.
תמיכה מקצועית בצוותי האחזקה והייצור, תוך עמידה בדרישות בטיחות, איכות ונהלי החברה.

מהנדס/ת חשמל או הנדסאי/ת חשמל מוסמך

ידע בקריאת תוכניות חשמל, מפרטים ותוכניות הנדסיות.
יכולת ניתוח תקלות והובלת פתרונות הנדסיים.
ניסיון בליווי פרויקטים ובעבודה מול קבלנים וספקים.
היכרות עם מערכות אנרגיה, מיזוג אוויר וקירור, אוויר דחוס, מים ושפכים – יתרון.

title: Machine Operator- מפעיל.ת מכונה עפולה
snippet:
Job Description
הצטרפו לצוות שמאחורי מותגים אייקוניים כמו Huggies® ®, , Depend®
בקימברלי-קלארק, הכל כאן בשבילכם , חדשנות, צמיחה והזדמנות לעשות השפעה אמיתית.
נוצרת כדי ליצור טיפול טוב יותר לעולם טוב יותר: זו ההזדמנות שלך להפעיל מכונה שמייצרת מוצרים מהשורה הראשונה לרבע מאוכלוסיית העולם. תזכה להכרה לעיתים קרובות על ידי המנהל שלך, לתמוך בצוות שלך, ולראות את המוצרים שאתה מייצר משמשים את המשפחה שלך בסופו של דבר. זה מתחיל איתך.
עליך:
באחד מתפקידי הייצור שלנו, תתמקד בניצחון עם הצרכנים והשוק, תוך שמירה על בטיחות, כבוד הדדי וכבוד האדם במרכז.
תחומי אחריות עיקריים:
הפעלת המכונה
הזנת חומרי גלם
פתרון תקלות
תחזוקה בסיסית
אחריות על סדר וניקיון בסביבות העבודה.
התנהלות ישירה מול מנהל המכונה ומחלקות האחזקה במקרים של תקלות.
כדי להצליח בתפקיד זה, תצטרך את ההסמכות הבאות
השכלה – 12 שנות לימוד.
ניסיון קודם בהפעלת מכונה – יתרון.
רישיון מלגזה – יתרון
ניסיון של שנה לפחות בתפקיד דומה - יתרון
עבודה בשלוש משמרות : שבוע בוקר 07:00-15:30 , שבוע ערב 15:00-23:30 , שבוע לילה 23:00-07:30 ,
בנוסף עבודה בימי שישי )כשעובדים משמרת בוקר באותו שבוע ) - 07:00-12:00
ומוצ"ש - כשעובדים באותו שבוע משמרת לילה 23:00-07:30
בהובלת מטרה. מונע על ידך.
הטבות:
קליטה לחברה מהיום הראשון
סביבת עבודה תומכת ומתגמלת
סל רווחה - מתנות בחגים , ימי כיף לעובדי החברה
חדר אוכל פעיל במפעל
מערך הסעות מהאזור
להגשת מועמדות
לחץ/י על כפתור הגשת מועמדות והשלם/י את הגשת המועמדות שלך. צוות הגיוס שלנו יבחן את הבקשה שלך ויהיה איתך בקשר אם נראה שאת/ה מתאים/ה לתפקיד זה.
בינתיים, אנו מזמינים אותך להיכנס לאתר אתר הקריירה שלנו, שם תוכל/י למצוא מידע נוסף ומשרות נוספות.
האותיות הקטנות:
כדי שקימברלי-קלארק תמשיך לצמוח ולשגשג, עלינו להיות ארגון המיישם את הניסיון המגוון של חברי הצוות שלו למותגים שמשפרים את חייהם של אנשים ברחבי העולם. אנו פועלים באופן פעיל לבניית כוח עבודה מגוון המשקף את חוויות הצרכנים שלנו. כאשר את/ה מביא/ה את החשיבה המקורית שלך לקימברלי-קלארק, את/ה תורמ/ת להצלחה המתמשכת שלנו. אנו מחויבים להיות מעסיק שוויוני המאפשר לכל המועמדים המתאימים לקבל הזדמנות להעסקה ללא קשר לגזע, צבע, דת, מין, מוצא לאומי, מצב נכות, מעמד ותיק מוגן, נטייה מינית, זהות מגדרית, גיל, הריון, מידע גנטי, מעמד אזרחי או כל מאפיין אחר המוגן על פי חוק.
ההצהרות הנ"ל נועדו לתאר את האופי הכללי ורמת העבודה המבוצעת על ידי עובדים המשויכים לסיווג זה. ההצהרות אינן מיועדות להיחשב כרשימה ממצה של כל החובות, האחריות והכישורים הנדרשים לתפקיד זה.
Primary Location
Afula Plant
Additional Locations
Worker Type
Employee
Worker Sub-Type
Regular
Time Type
Full time

title: Technician for Elevator and Escalator Modernization
snippet:
🇮🇱 ISRAELI CITIZENS ONLY |
Company: Khasin On Time LTD (חסין בזמן בע"מ)
Location: Central District, Israel Employment
Type: Full-Time
About the Job
Khasin On Time LTD is looking for skilled and motivated technical professionals to join our team specializing in elevator and escalator modernization.
We especially encourage Russian-speaking professionals with hands-on technical experience to apply! We welcome candidates from various technical backgrounds, including mechanics, electrical work, electronics, equipment repair, and industrial maintenance.No previous experience with elevators or escalators is required!
We provide full professional training at the company's expense.
Key Responsibilities:
Participate in elevator and escalator modernization projects.
Replace, upgrade, and install mechanical and electrical components.
Perform technical work in accordance with established quality and safety standards.
Diagnose technical issues and assist in troubleshooting.
Work alongside an experienced team of technical professionals.
Requirements:
Israeli citizenship is mandatory.
Practical experience in mechanics, electrical systems, electronics, equipment repair, industrial maintenance, or related technical fields.
Strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience with tools.
Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and equipment.
Responsible, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a team.
Russian and/or Hebrew communication skills for professional interaction.
Experience with elevators or escalators is an advantage but NOT required.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary.
Full professional training paid for by the company.
Company vehicle for eligible candidates.
Stable, long-term, full-time employment.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Hands-on experience with modern technical equipment.
Supportive and professional working environment.
Preferred Locations: We especially welcome candidates living in: Rishon LeZion, Rehovot, Ramla, Ness Ziona, Yavne, Bat Yam, and surrounding areas in Central Israel.
Interested in Joining Our Team?
If you are an Israeli citizen, speak Russian and/or Hebrew, have a technical background, and are looking for a stable career opportunity, we would love to hear from you!
Apply through LinkedIn and take the next step in your technical career. Company Website: www.dragnoa.com

title: Engineering Technician - R&D
snippet:
Helios is seeking a hands-on Engineering Technician to build and support the mechanical systems behind our chemical process R&D platforms - and to own the workshop that makes that possible. You'll set the standards for how work gets done on the floor, and you'll hold the team to them.
About Helios
Helios develops cutting-edge iron refining technologies that minimize environmental impact and maximize resource efficiency. We operate at the intersection of materials science, chemical engineering, and mechanical innovation. If you're passionate about building systems that shape the future of sustainable industry, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll Do
Build and Fabricate
Assemble mechanical prototypes based on CAD models, drawings, or experimental needs - custom vessels, fixtures, and assemblies for high-temperature, high-pressure, and chemically reactive environments.
Fabricate custom jigs, frames, piping, and related assemblies to support R&D system builds and experiments.
Apply thermal solutions, including integration of heating elements and insulation, for prototype and test systems.
Collaborate with engineers to translate design intent into physical builds and iterate quickly based on test results.
Own the lab and pilot ticketing system, managing and resolving service and maintenance requests.
Run the Workshop
Keep the workshop organized and functional: sensible layout, tools where people can find them, clear storage and labeling, and good housekeeping habits.
Operate and maintain workshop tools and equipment (drills, 3D printers, lathe, mill, TIG/MIG), keeping them serviced and in working order.
Set up simple, practical working methods - basic procedures, checklists, and tool-use rules - and make sure the team follows them.
Promote safe working practices by writing clear work procedures and enforcing PPE use.
Manage consumables, raw stock, and assembly hardware - know what we have and reorder before it runs out.
Handle purchasing of workshop and build materials and interface with suppliers, machine shops, and fabricators locally and internationally, so builds aren't held up waiting on parts.
Help expand workshop capability over time by identifying gaps and suggesting new tools and equipment.
What You Bring
Core
Technical diploma or engineering degree in mechanical, mechatronics, or related field.
3+ years of hands-on experience in metal prototyping, fabrication, and mechanical assembly.
Experience keeping a workshop or lab organized and stocked, or a clear readiness to take that on.
Comfort managing consumables and coordinating orders with suppliers.
Strong familiarity with workshop tools and fabrication techniques.
Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and BOMs.
Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Onshape) for jig design and 3D printing.
Basic electrical skills (e.g., wiring, sensor setup).
Comfortable working in a fast-paced R&D environment with evolving requirements.
Professional fluency in English (spoken and written).
Advantage
Experience with inventory or purchasing tools of any kind, including a well-run spreadsheet system you built yourself.
Hand milling, lathe work, or CNC machining.
Practical welding experience for prototyping and fabrication work.
Licensed Electrician

We provide full professional training at the company's expense.

Participate in elevator and escalator modernization projects.
Replace, upgrade, and install mechanical and electrical components.
Perform technical work in accordance with established quality and safety standards.
Diagnose technical issues and assist in troubleshooting.
Work alongside an experienced team of technical professionals.
Requirements:
Israeli citizenship is mandatory.
Practical experience in mechanics, electrical systems, electronics, equipment repair, industrial maintenance, or related technical fields.
Strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience with tools.
Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and equipment.
Responsible, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a team.
Russian and/or Hebrew communication skills for professional interaction.
Experience with elevators or escalators is an advantage but NOT required.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary.
Full professional training paid for by the company.
Company vehicle for eligible candidates.
Stable, long-term, full-time employment.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Hands-on experience with modern technical equipment.
Supportive and professional working environment.
Preferred Locations: We especially welcome candidates living in: Rishon LeZion, Rehovot, Ramla, Ness Ziona, Yavne, Bat Yam, and surrounding areas in Central Israel.
Interested in Joining Our Team?
If you are an Israeli citizen, speak Russian and/or Hebrew, have a technical background, and are looking for a stable career opportunity, we would love to hear from you!
Apply through LinkedIn and take the next step in your technical career. Company Website: www.dragnoa.com

title: טכנאי אינטגרציה — מערכות אוטונומיות
snippet:
פתרונות סולאריים
מתכננת ומייצרת מתקנים אוטונומיים המשלבים אנרגיה סולארית, אגירה ותקשורת אלחוטית — מערכות שעובדות 24/7 גם בלי תשתית חשמל או תקשורת. מעל 1,000 מערכות מקוונות ברחבי הארץ.
אנחנו מחפשים טכנאי אינטגרציה לצוות שלנו ברשפון.
התפקיד
הרכבה, אינטגרציה והפעלה של מערכות אוטונומיות — מהתכנון בסדנה ועד ההתקנה בשטח (עבודת ידיים של הרכבת מערכות). כולל איתור ופתרון תקלות, בסדנה ומול מערכות מרוחקות.
יתרון
רקע בתקשורת רדיו, סלולרית או קווית רקע בחשמל אלקטרוניקה ניסיון בהרכבה, הפעלה ותחזוקה — בסדנה ובשטח
חשוב לדעת
התפקיד כולל יציאה להתקנות בשטח, ולעיתים עבודה בגובה.

title: Customer Support Technician - Kiryat Gat
snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Kiryat Gat,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
We are looking for a talented
customer support technician
to join our account team & integrate within our field support group in
Kiryat Gat
to provide a unique customer experience by demonstrating outstanding technical capabilities and inter-personal skills.
What’s in it for you?
As a customer support technician at Applied Materials you’ll be working for a high growth international company, integrating into the heart of the manufacturing process of advanced digital devices. You’ll get the opportunity and practice to work on the most advanced semiconductor equipment while learning new skills or perfecting existing ones such as advanced trouble shooting and problem solving, project management, robotics, semiconductor device manufacturing processes and more. In addition, you’ll get advanced training on cutting edge hardware industry components.
Role Responsibilities:
Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
Use digital analytics for troubleshooting
Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
Practical Engineer or Tecnician in Electrical Engineering or Mechatronics or mecanical
Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
Fluent in English
Willing to travel -30%
Has a valid passport
Preferred Qualifications:
1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
Experience with electronic / mechanic equipment – advantage
Work is located in Kiryat Gat in a cleanroom environment
Work in shifts including nights and weekends
Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 25% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Advanced Drone R&D Engineer
snippet:
Regulus is an agile defense-tech startup tackling the most complex challenges in counter-drone and uncrewed defense. With hundreds of combat-proven systems deployed by the IDF and global partners, we are now engineering the next generation of C-UxS (Counter-Uncrewed Systems). We leverage advanced electronic warfare and kinetic measures to detect and neutralize hostile threats. If you want to push technological boundaries while safeguarding Israel and our allies, join us at this pivotal stage of our growth.
This is a unique opportunity to join a company at a pivotal growth stage and help shape its products, culture, and future.
We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on
Advanced Drone R&D Engineer
to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, assembling, and testing advanced drone technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct in-depth research on drone hardware, datalinks, radios, and RF protocols (including ELRS, LoRa, and DJI systems).
Research and evaluate RF jamming techniques, spoofing, and anti-jamming solutions.
Assemble, wire, and integrate various drone components, payloads, and Linux-based companion computers using TCP/IP networking.
Configure and test multi-constellation GNSS systems, including RTK setups and satellite tracking optimization.
Perform precise soldering, wiring, and electronic troubleshooting in a lab environment.
Write clear, detailed technical reports on research findings, assembly procedures, and test results for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Requirements:
Strong understanding of drone flight controllers, datalinks, radios, and RF protocols
Familiarity with link budgets, antenna gain, signal attenuation, and GNSS/GPS tracking (ephemeris, cold starts).
Proficiency in Linux (command line) and TCP/IP networking.
Proven experience in drone assembly, including the ability to solder and work with small electronic components.
Excellent written communication skills with the ability to produce clear and concise technical reports.
Demonstrated ability to fly multirotor and/or fixed-wing drones - Advantage

title: IT Operations Specialist
snippet:
IT Operations Specialist | Entry-Level Opportunity
Looking to start your career in IT? Your technical background could be your first step into IT Operations!
A leading organization in Central Israel is looking for a motivated
IT Operations Specialist
to join its technology operations team.
This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with a technical background from academic studies, professional training, or military service who want to gain hands-on experience working with IT systems, infrastructure, and enterprise technology environments.
Previous professional IT experience is not required.
We're looking for candidates with a solid technical foundation, strong problem-solving abilities, and a genuine interest in developing a career in IT Operations.
What You'll Do
Monitor and support the daily operation of IT systems and services.
Track system availability, operational processes, and infrastructure performance.
Identify technical issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate incidents when needed.
Work with operating systems, servers, and monitoring tools.
Document technical incidents, service requests, and operational activities.
Collaborate with System, Networking, Infrastructure, and Information Security teams.
Perform routine IT operational tasks according to established procedures.
Learn new technologies, tools, and enterprise systems as part of the role.
Requirements
Relevant technical background from academic studies, professional training, or military service.
Basic familiarity with operating systems and IT environments.
Technical orientation and basic troubleshooting abilities.
Strong motivation to begin or develop a career in IT.
Ability to learn independently and adapt quickly to new technologies.
Organized, systematic, and detail-oriented working approach.
Strong personal responsibility and teamwork skills.
Good interpersonal communication and customer service mindset.
Advantages
Professional training or certification in System Administration, Networking, or IT.
Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems.
Basic knowledge of Active Directory.
Understanding of fundamental computer networking concepts.
Familiarity with IT monitoring tools.
Relevant technical experience gained during military service.
Position Details
Location:
Central Israel
Employment Type:
Full-time
Experience Level:
Entry-level – No previous professional IT experience required.
If you're technically curious, enjoy solving problems, and want to build your career in IT infrastructure and operations, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Field Service Technician
snippet:
About Xerox Holdings Corporation
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
Overview:
Join Xerox as a Field Service Technician and become part of a growing Technical Services organization focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience. In this hands-on role, you will use your electro-mechanical expertise to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment while helping maximize device availability and performance. Xerox provides technical training to help you build the product knowledge and skills needed to successfully support your assigned territory.
Why Join This Team:
Receive technical training from certified instructors through online and instructor-led learning
Build your expertise in electro-mechanical troubleshooting and equipment repair
Access career development and growth opportunities within Technical Services
Receive comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness credits, and a company contribution to a Health Savings Account
Participate in a 401(k) program with company matching
Receive paid time off, holidays, and personal days
What You Will Do:
Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment using electrical and mechanical knowledge
Deliver professional, responsive customer service while helping minimize equipment downtime
Use diagnostic tools, including a multimeter, and interpret electrical schematics to identify and resolve equipment issues
Manage assigned service calls and territory responsibilities while meeting established productivity, response time, quality, and cost expectations
Maintain the equipment, parts, and inventory required to effectively support customers within your assigned territory
What You Need to Succeed
:
Electro-mechanical troubleshooting experience with the ability to use a multimeter and interpret electrical schematics
Strong customer service, time management, problem-solving, and organizational skills
Ability to work independently in a field-based environment while reliably meeting customer and service commitments
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and regularly walk, stand, squat, bend, and drive for more than 50 percent of the workday
This position requires a valid driver's license, current automobile insurance coverage meeting company-specified minimums, and the ability to meet the company's motor vehicle safety standards.
How We Set You Up for Success:
Structured new-hire and technical training designed to prepare you for independent field service work
Training on Xerox equipment, troubleshooting procedures, inventory requirements, and customer service expectations
Clear expectations regarding service call volume, territory responsibilities, and customer satisfaction
Hands-on preparation to independently complete service calls accurately and efficiently
Supportive and collaborative environment with opportunities for continued career development

title: טכנאי/ת מעבדת הוראה
snippet:
א
טכנאי/ת מעבדת הוראה
אוניברסיטת תל אביב
תל אביב
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 3 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
טכנאי/ת מעבדת הוראה שנה א'- ביה"ס לפיזיקה ולאסטרונומיה
תפעול ותחזוקת מעבדות ההוראה בפיזיקה:• סיוע בתפעול המעבדה לרבות אחזקה שוטפת, תפעול ניסויים, הדרכה ותמיכה מקצועית במדריכי המעבדה.
• תפעול מערכות תשתית המעבדה ומעקב אחר אחזקה מתוכננת ואחזקת שבר.
• סיוע בתכנון, פיתוח ושיפור של סביבת העבודה - ניסויים וציוד מדעי.
• סיוע בניהול מערך מלאי של ציוד/מכשור/כימיקלים וכו', כולל ביצוע הזמנות, רכש ותכנון עתידי.
• הדרכה טכנית של מדריכי מעבדה (תלמידי תואר שני ושלישי) וסיוע לתלמידי התואר הראשון בזמן הקורס.
• סיוע בפיתוח ובקידום נושאי הליבה במעבדה בצמוד למנהל הטכני ולצוות האקדמי.
• ייזום ופיתוח פרויקטים שונים, לטובת קידום וחדשנות במעבדה.
• קיום קשר מקצועי רציף עם הצוות האקדמי.
• אחריות לנושא הבטיחות במעבדה.
• ביצוע מטלות נוספות ככל שיידרש.
דרישות התפקיד
• הנדסאי/ת / מהנדס/ת בתחומי אלקטרוניקה/מחשבים/מכטרוניקה, או תחום רלוונטי אחר. תואר ראשון בפיזיקה - יתרון.• ניסיון בעבודת מעבדה הכוללת הכרות ותפעול של צב"ד, ציוד מתקדם אלקטרוני ומכני ועזרי הוראה מגוונים.
• ניסיון בתפעול מערכות ממוחשבות ועבודה בסביבה ממוחשבת.
• יכולת זיהוי, ניתוח ופתרון תקלות ובעיות טכניות.
• יכולות ניהול פרויקטים מעבדתיים - הבנת הצורך, מחקר, אפיון, יישום והטמעה.
• יכולות פיתוח באלקטרוניקה ואלקטרו מכניקה.
• הכרות ויכולות פיתוח בשפות תכנות – PYTHON , C++ ועוד - יתרון.
• הכרות טובה עם חיישנים ותחום ה IOT - יתרון.
• ידיעת השפה העברית על בוריה וידיעת השפה האנגלית ברמה טובה מאד.
• יכולת למידה עצמית של תפעול ציוד חדש ומורכב, ויכולת התעדכנות מקצועית.
• יכולת עבודה עצמאית והשתלבות בצוות.
• יכולת התמודדות עם עומס משימות ולחץ.
• יכולות הדרכה.
• יצירתיות, יוזמה, יכולת הנעת תהליכים.
• תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש מעולים.
הערה: נדרשת נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות בהתאם לצורך, ובימי שישי (מס' פעמים במהלך שנת הלימודים).
כפיפות: למנהל הטכני מעבדה שנה א' ולמנהלת המערך המנהלי של בית הספר.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

title: R&D Ink Student
snippet:
Landa is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented student to join our R&D Ink team and support the development, testing, and characterization of inks used in Nanography technology. The role combines hands-on laboratory work with ink performance evaluation, supporting the release of new ink generations and continuous improvement of existing products.
Responsibilities:
Perform ink testing on Nanography laboratory systems and jigs.
Conduct print-quality and printing-characterization analyses.
Monitor and evaluate ink physical properties.
Requirements:
2nd- to 3rd-year students in Chemistry, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Electronics Engineering, or Practical Engineering students (Chemistry, Mechanical, or Electronics).
Availability to work 2-3 days per week (approximately 20-25 hours weekly).
Strong hands-on laboratory skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to quickly learn procedures and follow instructions.
Ability to work effectively within a team and under demanding timelines.
Positive attitude and hands-on approach.
Fast learner with a strong desire to deepen technical knowledge.
Self-motivated and independent.

title: Module Equipment / Operation Technician
snippet:
Job Details
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Manufacturing Technician, you will play a vital role in our high-volume production process by operating, monitoring, and maintaining advanced equipment to ensure efficiency and quality standards are met. You'll have hands-on involvement in troubleshooting and optimizing tools, conducting quality checks, and ensuring the seamless assembly of products. Your efforts will directly contribute to producing top-tier products that drive Intel's success in the technology industry.
Business Group
Join Intel Corporation, a global leader in semiconductor innovation, where you will be part of a dynamic team dedicated to advancing manufacturing excellence. Our team collaborates to deliver high-quality products that empower progress and innovation worldwide. We operate in fast-paced environments, leveraging cutting-edge processes and technologies that support Intel's broader mission of shaping the future of computing and connectivity.
Key Responsibilities
Operate, monitor, and maintain advanced manufacturing equipment to achieve output targets.
Conduct online equipment adjustments and optimize processes to maintain production efficiency.
Perform quality control evaluations on raw materials and finished products to ensure compliance with industry standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve nonstandard events in the production line to ensure stable operations.
Collaborate with the Manufacturing Operations Manager and team peers to meet production schedules and escalate risks when necessary.
Support installation, qualification, and maintenance of new or reused production equipment.
Maintain accurate production logs and required documentation per Standard Operating Procedures.
Drive cost and quality improvements and assist in incorporating process enhancements.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
Practical Engineer in a relevant technical field such as Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, or Hardware Engineering with hands-on experience gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.
Proficiency in technical English to interpret manuals, document logs, and communicate effectively.
Ability to work in a demanding 12-hour shift schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Preferred Qualifications
Relevant technical experience in a semiconductor cleanroom environment (FAB/SORT).
Hands-on expertise in operating, maintaining, or troubleshooting manufacturing equipment.
Familiarity with data-driven systems for tool monitoring and online adjustments.
Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the success of our manufacturing processes. We encourage you to bring your enthusiasm, technical skills, and dedication to this exciting opportunity to grow with Intel.
Job Type
Experienced Hire
Shift
Shift 1 C (Israel)
Primary Location:
Israel, Kiryat-Gat
Additional Locations:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.
Position of Trust
N/A

This role will require an on-site presence. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

title: Optical Technician
snippet:
אנו מחפשים
מרכיב/ה אופטו-מכאני/ת
מנוסה ומוכשר/ת להצטרף לצוות הפיתוח והייצור שלנו. תפקיד זה מהווה הזדמנות ייחודית לקחת חלק בהרכבת מערכות מתקדמות ופורצות דרך בתחום המשלב אופטיקה ומכאניקה מדויקת, ולעבוד בסביבה טכנולוגית חדשנית ודינמית.
כחלק מצוות הנדסה מוביל, תהיו אחראים/ות על ביצוע הרכבות עדינות ומורכבות בחדר נקי, תוך שימוש בטכנולוגיות מתקדמות. תעבדו עם מערכות לייזר, עדשות ומכלולים מכאניים מדויקים, ותתרמו באופן ישיר לאיכות ולביצועי המוצרים שלנו. סביבת העבודה דורשת דיוק קפדני, אחריות אישית גבוהה ויכולת למידה מהירה.
תחומי האחריות:
הרכבת מערכות אופטו-מכאניות משולבות ומורכבות בחדר נקי.
ביצוע הרכבות עדינות של מכלולים מכאניים ואופטיים, כולל לייזרים ועדשות.
עבודה מול שרטוטים טכניים מורכבים והקפדה על דיוק מרבי.
הפעלת תוכנות ממוחשבות כחלק מתהליך ההרכבה והבדיקה.
שיתוף פעולה הדוק עם צוותי ההנדסה והייצור.
פיתוח וקידום רעיונות לשיפור תהליכי הרכבה וטכנולוגיות חדשות.
זוהי הזדמנות מצוינת לצמוח מקצועית בסביבה תומכת ומאתגרת, ולקחת חלק בפרויקטים בעלי השפעה טכנולוגית משמעותית. אנו מזמינים מועמדים/ות בעלי/ות תשוקה לדיוק וטכנולוגיה להצטרף למשפחתנו.
Requirements:
זיקה טכנית חזקה וידע מוכח בקריאת שרטוטים טכניים
- חובה.
הנדסאי/ת מכונות, אלקטרוניקה או חשמל
- יתרון משמעותי מאוד.
נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות ובימי שישי
, בהתאם לדרישות הפרויקט והצורך המבצעי.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית ויעילה בסביבת צוות, עם
תקשורת בין-אישית מצוינת
.
נמרצות, אחריות אישית גבוהה ויכולת עמידה בתנאי לחץ
, תוך הקפדה על שירותיות.
יכולת למידה מהירה
, יוזמה לפיתוח וקידום רעיונות וטכנולוגיות חדשות בתחום.

title: Customer Engineer - Kiryat Gat
snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Kiryat Gat,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.
J
Job Description
We are looking for a highly talented customer engineer to join our account team & integrate within our field support group in
Kiryat Gat
to provide a unique customer experience by demonstrating outstanding technical capabilities and inter-personal skills.
What’s in it for you?
As a customer engineer at Applied Materials you’ll be working for a high growth international company, integrating into the heart of the manufacturing process of advanced digital devices. You’ll get the opportunity and practice to work on the most advanced semiconductor equipment while learning new skills or perfecting existing ones such as advanced trouble shooting and problem solving, project management, robotics, semiconductor device manufacturing processes and more. In addition, you’ll get advanced training on cutting edge hardware industry components.
Role Responsibilities:
Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
Use digital analytics for troubleshooting
Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
B.Sc. or Practical Engineer in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering , field service experience, or trade certification
Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
Preferred Qualifications:
1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
Associate degree in electronics or engineering technologies
Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
Work is located in Kiryat Gat in a cleanroom environment
Work in shifts including nights and weekends
Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 25% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Operations Team Member
snippet:
Airobotics, a global leader in autonomous unmanned aerial systems (UAS), is seeking skilled and motivated professionals to join our Deployment and Technical Support team. The role includes deploying advanced autonomous systems at customer sites, operating the systems in day-to-day field activities, and providing direct technical support across civilian and defense projects.
Responsibilities:
Install, deploy, and operate autonomous systems at customer sites in Israel and occasionally abroad.
Perform system operation tasks during missions, demos, and routine activities.
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues in the field.
Provide ongoing technical support to customers, including documentation and follow-up of solutions.
Requirements:
Strong technical aptitude with excellent hands-on skills and fine motor abilities.
Fast learner with the ability to quickly understand new systems and technologies.
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
Willingness to work in demanding field conditions, including overnight stays outside home.
Service-oriented, proactive, positive attitude, and “can-do” mindset.
High-level English (speaking, reading, writing) – mandatory.
Valid driver’s license (B) – mandatory.
Significant Advantages
Previous drone operation/flying experience.
CAAI (IAA) remote pilot license up to 25 kg.
Background in industrial or defense environments.
Foreign passport – strong advantage for international project readiness.

title: Hardware System Engineer
snippet:
About the company
ATOM develops an AI-based QA/QC platform for buildings in the early stages of construction. Our camera systems already operate on cranes and capture site data for analysis.
We need a hands-on systems engineer to improve, expand, and strengthen these systems. You will work on the complete system: cameras, sensors, power, communications, and software integration.
What you will do
Further develop our existing camera system and integrate optics, positioning sensors, power, and communications.
Make systems reliable in heat, rain, dust, wind, and vibration.
Work with technical partners to develop, build, and test solutions in the lab and on cranes.
Write basic code to control devices, collect data, and run tests.
Improve image quality, positioning accuracy, reliability, and cost.
Prepare systems for easier manufacturing, installation, and maintenance.
What you need
Experience developing and integrating hardware systems that work outside the lab.
Strong systems thinking and hands-on troubleshooting skills.
Working knowledge of cameras and optics, including lenses, image quality, and lighting.
Basic coding skills, preferably Python, for testing and hardware integration.
Knowledge of electrical systems, networking, and communications.
Understanding of environmental effects on hardware and system performance.
Ability to work independently and take responsibility for the complete system.
An advantage
Experience with GNSS, RTK, IMU, robotics, or mechatronics.
Experience with camera calibration, embedded systems, or design for manufacturing.

סדר, דיוק והקפדה על איכות העבודה.

title: מהנדס/ת או הנדסאי/ת בקרה ואינטגרציית שטח
snippet:
אנחנו מגייסים – מהנדס/ת או הנדסאי/ת בקרה ואינטגרציית שטח!
חברת BLEnergy היא חברה מובילה בתחום אגירת האנרגיה בישראל ובחו"ל.
התפקיד כולל עבודה מעשית בשטח (Hands-on), הטמעה והרצה של מערכות בקרה, בדיקות תקשורת ואינטגרציה, ואיתור ופתרון תקלות בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת.
**תחומי אחריות**
-        התקנה, הטמעה והרצה (Commissioning) של תוכנות ומערכות בקרה באתרי פרויקטים
-        ביצוע בדיקות אינטגרציה ותקשורת מול חיישנים, רכיבי קצה וציוד היקפי
-        איתור ופתרון תקלות חומרה, תוכנה ותקשורת בזמן אמת
-        עבודה שוטפת מול צוותי הפיתוח וההנדסה בחברה
-        הובלת תהליכי אינטגרציה והתקנה בפרויקטים בארץ ובחו"ל
**דרישות התפקיד**
-        תואר מהנדס/ת או דיפלומת הנדסאי/ת בחשמל, אלקטרוניקה או תוכנה – חובה
-        ניסיון באינטגרציה ופתרון תקלות במערכות משולבות חומרה ותוכנה – חובה
-        ניסיון בעבודה עם פרוטוקולי תקשורת תעשייתיים (Modbus, Ethernet, Serial) – חובה
-        אנגלית ברמה גבוהה – חובה
-        יכולת עבודה עצמאית, יוזמה ויחסי אנוש מצוינים
-        נכונות לנסיעות ולטיסות תכופות לחו"ל
-        ניסיון מעשי בעבודה בסביבת Linux, כולל Terminal, הגדרות רשת וניתוח לוגים
**כישורים אישיים**
-        עצמאות גבוהה, יוזמה ויכולת קבלת החלטות בשטח
-        נכונות לנסיעות ולטיסות תכופות לחו"ל בהתאם לצורכי הפרויקטים
-        תקשורת בינאישית מעולה ויחסי אנוש מצוינים בעבודה מול צוותים פנימיים ולקוחות
מיקום: עבודה משולבת במשרד ובאתרי פרויקטים בארץ ובחו"ל

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
* עבודה בצוות גדול במגוון תחומים טכנולוגיים עם ממשקים להנדסה וגופים נוספים.
* ביצוע בחינה לביקורת סופית לחלקים ומוצרים במפעל ובקב"מ.
* ניתוח ממצאי ביקורת, הפקת חריגות, ויישום היתרים הנדסיים/ שינויים.
* הבנה בקריאת שרטוטים.
* הבנה טכנולוגית בפרוק והרכבת מוצרים לבדיקות הידראוליות ומכניות.
* ריכוז וסיכום ממצאי ביקורת, עבודה רבה במערכות מידע ועבודת ניירת של תיעוד הממצאים. נדרש דיוק והקפדה בתיעוד ובהפקת אישורים.
דרישות התפקיד
* טכנאי/ת/ הנדסאי/ת- יתרון.
* הכרת המחשב ותוכנות האופיס- חובה.
* קריאת שרטוט מכני, על בוריו- חובה.
* בעל/ת רקע בתחום האחזקה הטכני- יתרון.
* ידע וניסיון בהפעלה של מכשירי מדידה מדויקים- יתרון.
* ניסיון של שנה לפחות בבחינת קווי ייצור בדיקות לחץ ובחינות קבלה סופיות (יתרון משמעותי למפעל בתחום תעשיות המתכת)- יתרון.
* הבנה בתהליכי ייצור של תעשייה כבדה וקלה בכלל ענפי המתכת- יתרון.
* בעל/ת הכשרה כבוחן מוסמך (או רקע מקביל)- יתרון.
* ידע בתקני ביקורת איכות, שיטות דגימה, שיטות סטטיסטיות- יתרון.
* מיומנות עבודה במערכות מידע לניהול תהליכים בארגונים- יתרון.
* ידע וניסיון בהפעלת תוכנה לניהול והכנה של נתוני בחינה- יתרון.
* יחסי אנוש טובים.
* תודעת שירות גבוהה ויכולת טיפול במס' משימות במקביל תוך ירידה לפרטים.
* נכונות לשעות עבודה גמישות ונוספות.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

title: Systems & Integration Engineer
snippet:
Ottopia Defense | Systems & Operations
Ottopia Defense, part of Ondas, develops teleoperation and Hybrid AI technology for ground vehicles in defense applications. The Systems & Operations department turns this technology into integrated systems that can be deployed, supported, and reproduced.
This role will involve turning hardware and software components into working vehicle and operator systems within the systems engineering team. You will own integration, troubleshooting, and verification, with reproducible configurations and clear handover to system QA and delivery.
What you’ll do
Integrate computing, power, communications, sensors, and vehicle interfaces on the bench and in the field.
Translate system requirements and complex integrations into practical setups and designs.
Isolate and detect faults using measurements, logs and configuration evidence, and verify corrective actions.
Execute integration checks with system QA vectors, record results, and conduct performance research with the responsible engineering teams.
Maintain systems and setup documentation, manufacturing and engineering docs. BOM inputs and controlled hardware and software configurations.
Work with the systems team lead, SW R&D, operations and delivery to prepare repeatable builds and handovers.
What you bring
Practical experience integrating and troubleshooting physical systems that combine hardware and software.
Working understanding of electrical interfaces, computing and networks, with depth in a relevant area.
Ability to read technical diagrams and use measurements to test a diagnosis.
Experience documenting configurations, test results, and issues clearly for others to reproduce.
Clear communication in English and effective collaboration across engineering and operational teams.
How you work matters
We value ownership, integrity, and independent learning. Bring ideas, take responsibility and grow through feedback and shared work. Curiosity, sustained achievement and interests beyond work can add perspective; helping the team succeed is central.
Own commitments, follow issues through and raise risks early.
Learn independently, test assumptions and welcome constructive challenge.
Share knowledge, support colleagues and put the shared result first.
Connect your work to the wider system and act responsibly when priorities change.
Set high standards, show sustained achievement and seek broader responsibility.
An advantage
Experience with vehicles, robotics, embedded systems, rugged hardware or field integration. A relevant engineering degree or practical engineering qualification is an advantage.

title: Customer Engineer -Migdal Haemek
snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Mig Ha'emek,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.
Job Description
We are looking for a highly talented customer engineer to join our account team & integrate within our field support group in
Migdal Haemek
to provide a unique customer experience by demonstrating outstanding technical capabilities and inter-personal skills.
What’s in it for you?
As a customer engineer at Applied Materials you’ll be working for a high growth international company, integrating into the heart of the manufacturing process of advanced digital devices. You’ll get the opportunity and practice to work on the most advanced semiconductor equipment while learning new skills or perfecting existing ones such as advanced trouble shooting and problem solving, project management, robotics, semiconductor device manufacturing processes and more. In addition, you’ll get advanced training on cutting edge hardware industry components.
Role Responsibilities:
Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
Use digital analytics for troubleshooting
Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
B.Sc. or Practical Engineer in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering , field service experience, or trade certification
Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
Preferred Qualifications:
1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
Associate degree in electronics or engineering technologies
Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
Work is located in Migdal Haemek in a cleanroom environment
Work in shifts including nights and weekends
Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 20% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: IT/OT & Infrastructure Project Manager
snippet:
Ready to bridge the gap between IT infrastructure and industrial operations?
We’re looking for an
IT/OT & Infrastructure Project Manager
to lead technology projects across manufacturing facilities for a leading nationwide organization.
This role combines hands-on technical understanding of IT and OT environments with project leadership, infrastructure planning, cybersecurity, and collaboration with diverse stakeholders.
What will you do?
Lead IT/OT infrastructure projects across the company’s manufacturing facilities.
Identify and address infrastructure and cybersecurity gaps in production environments.
Support the implementation of new equipment and production lines.
Plan infrastructure and integrate industrial equipment into OT networks.
Work closely with maintenance managers, technical managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
Collaborate with international suppliers, leading technical discussions in English and driving alignment across teams.
What are we looking for?
3+ years of experience working with PLCs, industrial communication protocols, and HMI/SCADA systems.
Experience with IT infrastructure, including networking, cybersecurity, systems administration, and operating systems.
Experience working in a manufacturing environment or on a production floor within a large organization.
Experience planning infrastructure and integrating equipment into OT networks.
Fluent English – mandatory.
Advantages
Familiarity with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Unitronics.
Experience with System Platform and Cimplicity.
Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and BACnet.
📍
Location:
Petah Tikva, Israel
🏠
Work Model:
Hybrid, including travel to company manufacturing facilities.
Interested in leading projects at the intersection of IT, OT, and industrial infrastructure? We’d love to hear from you!

title: טכנאי אינטגרציה — מערכות משולבות
snippet:
פתרונות סולאריים
מתכננת ומייצרת מתקנים אוטונומיים המשלבים אנרגיה סולארית, אגירה ותקשורת אלחוטית — מערכות שעובדות 24/7 גם בלי תשתית חשמל או תקשורת. מעל 1,000 מערכות מקוונות ברחבי הארץ.
אנחנו מחפשים טכנאי אינטגרציה לצוות שלנו ברשפון.
התפקיד
הרכבה, אינטגרציה והפעלה של מערכות אוטונומיות — מהתכנון בסדנה ועד ההתקנה בשטח (עבודת ידיים של הרכבת מערכות). כולל איתור ופתרון תקלות, בסדנה ומול מערכות מרוחקות.
יתרון
רקע בתקשורת רדיו, סלולרית או קווית רקע בחשמל אלקטרוניקה ניסיון בהרכבה, הפעלה ותחזוקה — בסדנה ובשטח
חשוב לדעת
התפקיד כולל יציאה להתקנות בשטח, ולעיתים עבודה בגובה.
